title: Intent
description: The authored half of a part: what it is for, when it is wrong, its lifecycle, and what to reach for instead. Stored beside the generated catalog, never inside it, so a rebuild cannot overwrite a sentence someone wrote.

summary.description: One line on what this part is for.

whenToUse.description: The situation the part is the right answer for.

whenNotToUse.description: The situation it is the wrong answer for, and what to do instead.

states.description: Named states the part handles: loading, empty, error, disabled.

status.description: The lifecycle a consumer can rely on.

examples.description: Real call sites or canonical snippets that show the approved use.

useInstead.description: What to reach for instead, when a near-duplicate or a retirement exists.
